question: native subset rejection
scope: All 30 retained unique Strudel native note-output cases. Exclude analysis and repeats. This is the complete format population, not a representative sample across formats or future tasks.
method: Read all complete payloads and contracts. Validate JavaScript with official 1.2 transpiler. Decode each unmodified mini string and complete note/slow/sound chain with official mini1.2/core1.2. Deduplicate control-pattern query fragments with the same whole event span and pitch. Evaluate numeric .slow argument as JavaScript, query one lane period, and map cycles to four quarter-note beats per frozen prompt. Resolve MIDI via official noteToMidi. Manually check timing, pitch, and task requirements. Counterfactual components use frozen task checks on independently decoded engine notes; they do not replace frozen scores.
limitations: No audio engine or sample-bank test. Nominal event whole spans are the shared musical durations. Fragments with the same whole event span and pitch are one event, not repeated notes.
Voice prefixes retain the local lane convention; they are not public note identity.
Query one declared line period. Strudel patterns repeat; later repetitions are outside the finite task. Item slow operators can cross that period.
The fixed four-beat cycle is the task convention. setcpm(60) specifies cycles per minute, not quarter-note BPM.
All reviewed outputs violate some task requirement except seven controls. Wider parsing does not repair pitches, rest weights, or timing normalization.
Component accuracy is partial credit. The counterfactual has the same frozen checks and their weighting. It is not a new public-format conformance or musical-success metric.
